title: Orion and Osiris symbolism in the Apollo patch

tellings.quote: But, look again. Behind the A is the constellation Orion. And the crossbar of the A is deliberately aligned with Orion's belt.

plain: The patch of Apollo, NASA's 1960s programme to land people on the Moon, hides the constellation Orion behind its letter A, with the A's crossbar deliberately lined up with Orion's belt, Michels says. He tells this himself in an episode on pagan ritual at NASA, reading it as a nod to Osiris, the Egyptian god tied to Orion.
